formal: I began taking a new blood pressure tablet one month ago, and it causes me to feel somewhat dizzy when I stand up. My next appointment is in six weeks. My plan is to cut the tablets in half myself until that appointment. I rarely bring health questions of this kind to you, so asking now is unusual for me. I have weighed the dizziness upon standing against six more weeks at the full dose, and I have decided on this course of action. What is your view?
